answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Work waits on the forge until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the saffron of the next round. By the ocean of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, held in escrow until finality, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain.
